messages:
nora: AcmeCorp reporting intermittent 502/504s from hosted inference (/v1/chat/completions) since ~2024-12-01T12:30Z. They see the SDK enter a retry loop and duplicate charges. Sample request-id: x-request-id=acme-req-7721. Posting a minimal repro and response below.

deploy-bot: Alert: 502/504 spike on svc-hosted-gateway at 2024-12-01T12:31Z :eyes:

eli: Oncall here. Can you paste the raw request (no PII) and full headers including x-request-id?

nora: curl -i -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"short prompt"}],"max_tokens":512}'

Response snippet: HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
x-request-id: acme-req-7721
content-length: 0

(shows as immediate 504, no body)

sharon: Do they use streaming? SDK version? Any client-side connection pooling tweaks?

nora: Not streaming. They use python-sdk v0.9.1 with default retry policy (3 retries, no backoff). Their integration does ~10 concurrent requests per user session.

nate: I ran a repro harness against staging with the same concurrency and credential. When client concurrency >8 and keepalive disabled, gateway queue depth spikes and we start seeing 502/504 from the upstream inference pool. Repro script: 
```
# repro outline
for c in range(1,20):
  spawn POST /v1/chat/completions with concurrency=c
  wait 30s
```
Observed: p95 tail latencies jump, then gateway returns 504s when upstream worker threads block ~120ms+.

nate: Short-term mitigation: recommend changing SDK to exponential backoff (initial 200ms, factor 2, max 2s) and limit client concurrency to 8. Also suggests enabling connection keepalive.

eli: I can apply a temporary per-tenant ingress cap for AcmeCorp (8 concurrent) and an explicit throttling rule. Will push now and watch telemetry.

sharon: Filed INF-993 to investigate proxy connection reuse and eviction; hypothesis: proxy evicts idle conns causing expensive cold starts and queueing on backend. Will attach flame/conn traces.

alexa: (customer-success) I'll notify Acme: ask them to change SDK settings and to test with throttle on. I'll tell them we'll apply temp throttle and follow up with a plan. ETA update to customer in ~30m.

nora: Action items: 1) infra throttle applied; 2) customer asked to adjust SDK (backoff + concurrency); 3) eng-runtime to dig into keepalive/conn reuse. I'll follow up with status updates here.

eli: Throttle applied at 2024-12-01T13:05Z. Monitoring p50/p95 and error rates now. :thumbsup:

alexa: Acme acknowledged, testing now. Says errors stopped after they reduced concurrency and enabled keepalive.

nora: Marking P1 -> monitoring for 2 hours. If stable, we'll run a short postmortem and recommend default SDK retry/backoff changes and tenant ingress guidance.

customer-success: Customer-facing note: "We've applied a temporary throttle and recommended client changes (reduce concurrency, enable keepalive, add exponential backoff). We'll follow up with a permanent fix timeline once infra and runtime have root-caused INF-993."

eli: Updating incident tracker and will add links to dashboards.

nora: Thanks all — will update thread if anything changes.
summary: Support thread: AcmeCorp intermittent 502/504s on hosted inference; repro at high client concurrency; temporary per-tenant throttle applied; customer asked to change SDK backoff and concurrency; infra ticket INF-993 opened to investigate connection reuse.
